instruction: Change the VLC interface slider colours to a dark/blackish theme in preferences.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slider colours to dark/blackish values in VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Interface > Use custom colors). The evaluator checks VLC config file qt-slider-colours setting, verifying all RGB values are below 100 (blackish threshold). Uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric with 'blackish' type from vlc.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file from appropriate OS-specific location using get_vlc_config
Metric check_qt_slider_colours correctly parses qt-slider-colours setting (semicolon-separated RGB values)
Blackish verification logic is sound: checks all RGB components are below threshold 100
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] properly
Expected value {'type': 'blackish'} semantically matches instruction requirement for 'dark/blackish theme'
Evaluator provides complete coverage of instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to ensure VLC settings are persisted before evaluation (VLC auto-saves but explicit save could be more robust)
Minor: Could add logging/error handling for edge case where qt-slider-colours key is missing from config file
